where: Shangri-La (Zhongdian), Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, northwest Yunnan, China, 3,200 m on the edge of the Tibetan plateau
season: Early October on the Tibetan plateau: Napa Lake full after the summer rains, the wide grassland turning golden-brown, dark conifer forest on the surrounding hills, deep-blue high-altitude sky with a few small white clouds, crisp clear air

shots.label: hook
shots.view: Napa Lake (Napahai): a calm wide lake with the forested hills and distant mountain ridges mirrored perfectly in the water, golden-brown grassland along the shore, small white clouds reflected, strings of colourful prayer flags fluttering on poles along the shore
shots.action: She stands still at the water's edge seen from close behind her right shoulder, a light breeze lifting her braids and the white fur trim of her red robe, looking out over the lake.
shots.move: Start close behind her shoulder, then glide very slowly backwards and up at one gentle constant speed to reveal the whole lake and its mirrored mountains; she stays in the lower third.

shots.view: the grassy shore of Napa Lake, shallow clear water with reeds, the lake and hills stretching behind, a line of colourful prayer flags strung along the shore stirring gently in a light breeze
shots.action: She walks slowly along the shore from left to right, looking out over the water.
shots.move: Camera locked on a tripod, perfectly still; she walks slowly into the frame and along the shore, medium-wide on the left third, the lake filling the frame.

shots.view: the vast Napa grassland in calm, windless morning air: a flat meadow of short golden-brown turf grazed low by yaks, reaching to the forested hills, a small herd of black and white yaks grazing in the middle distance, mountain ridges under a clear blue sky
shots.move: Locked-off tripod shot from a slightly raised viewpoint looking out over the meadow, the camera perfectly still; the grass is short and still, only the yaks graze slowly. No tall grass, no close foreground: the bottom of the frame is short turf several metres away.
shots.ambience: soft breeze, a distant yak bell

shots.view: inside the giant prayer-flag canopy of Shangri-La on a flat light-grey gravel square in bright sun: one tall smooth copper-coloured pole in the middle; from its top thousands of strings run straight down and out to the ground on every side like the ribs of a huge round tent, each string hung with rows of small pennant-shaped flags, so the inside of the tent is a fine net of horizontal rings of little flags: mostly white and pale blue, with rings of red, green, yellow and blue, sky and white clouds showing through everywhere; around the foot of the pole a big neat stepped cone of layered cloth bands in red, green, yellow, blue and white, its lowest tier red; a few visitors in Tibetan robes far away
shots.action: She walks slowly in from the edge across the open gravel toward the tiered cone at the foot of the pole, then pauses and looks up at the rings of flags, calm and moved. Seen from behind and slightly to the side, medium-wide, the dome of flags filling the frame above and around her.
shots.move: Camera locked on a tripod, slightly low, perfectly still; she walks into the frame and the dome of flags stays still above her. No follow, no pan.
shots.ambience: prayer flags rustling softly in a light breeze

ref.what: the giant prayer-flag canopy of Shangri-La (the tent of flag strings, the copper pole and the stepped cone of cloth at its foot); the girl in it is the traveller herself, so her face in the photo is her real face. Her clothes in the photo are NOT used: she wears the bright-red robe with red sleeves and the white fur hat described below

shots.view: looking up from inside the giant prayer-flag canopy at the top of the copper pole: thousands of small pennant flags on strings in concentric rings around the pole top (mostly white and pale blue with rings of red, yellow, green and blue), like the inside of a huge round tent, sky showing through
shots.move: The camera points straight up at the zenith, locked and perfectly still, the pole top in the centre of the frame; only the flags stir gently. No tilt, no zoom.

ref.what: the inside of the giant prayer-flag canopy of Shangri-La: concentric rings of small flags around the pole top and the stepped cone of cloth at the pole's foot

shots.view: Ganden Sumtseling Monastery (Songzanlin), the largest Tibetan Buddhist monastery in Yunnan: white-walled monk quarters climbing a hillside to the great assembly halls on top with gilded golden roofs, red and white Tibetan walls, the small Lapa Lake in front reflecting it
shots.move: Majestic wide establishing shot from across Lapa Lake, very slow push-in at one constant speed.
shots.ambience: breeze, distant birds, faint wind chimes

shots.view: the wide stone visitor stairway leading up to the golden-roofed main assembly hall of Songzanlin Monastery, white and red walls on both sides
shots.action: She walks calmly up the stone steps, then pauses and looks up at the golden roofs, admiring them. Seen from behind and slightly to the side.
shots.move: Camera locked on a tripod at the foot of the stairs, perfectly still; she walks slowly up the steps away from it, the monastery filling the upper frame.
shots.ambience: footsteps on stone, breeze, faint chimes

shots.view: a cobbled street of Dukezong Ancient Town: two-storey traditional Tibetan wooden houses with dark timber facades, carved and painted window frames, prayer flags strung above, warm shop windows
shots.action: She walks slowly along the cobbled street, glancing at the carved facades.
shots.move: Very slow, gimbal-smooth tracking shot gliding backwards ahead of her at her slow walking pace; she is medium-wide, the street and facades fill the frame.
shots.ambience: footsteps on cobbles, distant town murmur

shots.view: close detail of an old carved and painted wooden door in Dukezong, warm light glowing from the shop window beside it
shots.move: Locked-off shot square to the door, a barely perceptible slow push-in; no sideways move.

shots.view: a worn wooden table by the window of a small teahouse in Dukezong, a simple white porcelain tea cup on it
shots.action: Tight close-up on the table: her two hands (five fingers each, the colourful striped cuffs of her red robe folded back, white fur trim) wrap around the warm tea cup; thin wisps of steam rise slowly from the tea and curl in the window light. The frame shows only the table, the cup, the steam and her hands and wrists: the top edge of the frame stays below her chest for the whole clip, her face, hair and shoulders never appear.
shots.move: Locked close-up, the camera does not move, tilt or pull back; only the steam and a slight shift of her fingers move.
shots.ambience: soft cup on wood, distant street

shots.view: the window seat of a small wooden teahouse in Dukezong, the old cobbled street visible outside in warm late-afternoon light
shots.action: She sits by the window holding the tea cup in both hands, quietly watching people pass in the street, calm, relaxed.
shots.move: Locked medium-wide shot from inside the teahouse, very slight slow push-in.

shots.view: the giant golden prayer wheel on Guishan Park hill above Dukezong Ancient Town in bright early dusk: an enormous gilded cylinder several storeys tall, its surface embossed with rows of seated Buddha figures and lotus patterns, a flared gilded crown on top, glowing warm gold under its floodlights against a soft blue-and-peach sky; a few visitors in warm coats walking slowly around its base pushing the wheel, which turns slowly
shots.action: The wheel turns slowly and steadily; visitors walk calmly around it.
shots.move: Locked-off camera from low at the foot of the wheel looking up at it, perfectly still; only the wheel turns and people walk.
shots.ambience: the wheel's low rumble, soft footsteps, evening breeze, a distant bell

shots.view: Guishan Park hill above Dukezong at sunset, beside the giant golden prayer wheel, the old town's glowing rooftops spread below
shots.action: She stands at the railing seen from behind, nothing on her back (no backpack, no bag), looking out over the rooftops, the breeze moving her hair. Still and calm.
shots.move: Very slow push-in from behind her over her shoulder toward the glowing town.
shots.ambience: evening breeze, faint prayer flags flapping

shots.view: the whole of Dukezong Ancient Town in bright early dusk seen from Guishan hill: hundreds of warm lights glowing in the wooden houses and streets, the illuminated golden prayer wheel in the foreground, soft mountains against a luminous pastel pink and pale-blue sky
shots.move: Lingering wide shot with a very slow pull-back, almost still.
